items.title: $3 trillion wipe-out, CEOs on the volatility of politics, and the status of the AI trade
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi gives his thoughts on the recent tech sell-off and what a bear market means for the AI trade. Plus, what the Qualcomm (QCOM) CEO and other business leaders are saying about the volatile state of politics. 

Sozzi sits down for a 1-on-1 with Affirm (AFRM) CEO Max Levchin to discuss the company's earnings and the midterm results.

items.title: Data centers are unpopular — and a key motor of economic growth

items.title: Anthropic’s “Down Quarter” Highlights Broadcom’s $161 Billion Risk

items.title: Alphabet’s Drone Unit to Invest Up to $125 Million in New Texas Facility
items.summary: Wing is investing up to $125 million over the next two years on a new manufacturing facility in Fort Worth, with the capacity to build tens of thousands of aircraft each year.

items.title: Warby Parker Sets Sights On Smart Glasses Launch
items.summary: Designer eyewear firm Warby Parker will begin taking preorders on Nov. 12 for its first smart glasses, branded Intelligent Eyewear.

items.title: Microsoft and Google Face a New Bill as Data Centers “Have to Pay Their Own Costs”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysVoters turned against new data centers in the Nov. 3 midterms, and Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta now face rules that make them pay for their own power and grid.
